throughput Metal neural and embedding/rotary/masked attention workflows
checks.gpu_module_path: GPU consumer, core, GPU adapter and published numerical/native modules; no CPU backend, layer, transformer, training or data modules

numerical_validation: Exact CPU parity for FP32/INT32/BOOL comparisons and selection, NaN/infinity/signed-zero classification and high-rank mask broadcasts
All nine public word-type cast pairs, including Java saturation, NaN-to-int, signed zero and integers beyond exact FP32 representation
Boolean ALL with true/false/scalar/empty inputs; empty identity true
General gather across a strided source and multidimensional repeated strided indices; exact input/embedding gradients
Integer and Boolean gathers, scalar and empty indices, zero-filled empty scatter and serial cancellation order
Concat and stepped slice gradients, including empty parts, integer/Boolean copies and a direct negative-axis kernel contract
First-tie/first-NaN max and argmax, signed zero selection, and multi-axis max gradient layout restoration
RoPE forward/backward exact CPU bits for both pairing layouts, broadcast/scalar positions through Integer.MAX_VALUE and long offsets above 2^40
Supplied-weight embedding, RoPE and masked grouped-query attention: CPU output and embedding/value gradient parity, fully masked query rows zero
Ten invalid-index/negative-position scenarios across both modes report KERNEL_ERROR, including empty gather/scatter domains
Fourteen injected rotary scratch allocation failures across both modes release NNJava handles and aborted recordings
Independent module-path consumer uses device-produced token/position IDs, causal attention, autograd, finite-gradient ALL and argmax

contracts.word_and_index_tier: DynamisGPU primitives with exact word or fixed serial FP32 contracts in both modes
contracts.rope_tier: Vectrix GpuRope in both modes, requiring INT64; FP32-table throughput rotation does not silently replace public CPU semantics
contracts.gqa_composition: Exact mode compares CPU bits; throughput mode uses fixture-relative tolerance 3e-4, not a whole-model bound
contracts.residency: No token/explicit-position numerical readbacks; runtime error checks transfer small status reports
contracts.host_preparation: Vectrix constructs rotary inverse frequencies; implicit positions and max row offsets derive from shape/caller metadata

limits: No custom NNJava shaders, float atomics or implicit CPU numerical fallback
Exact numerical comparisons retain upstream subnormal/flush-to-zero limits
New tensor programs use FP32, INT32 and BOOL; FP16/BF16 remain storage types
RoPE requires an even positive feature dimension, base greater than one and INT64 device capability
Per-call plans, packing and dispatch overhead remain performance work
Full generic GPU transformer inference still needs model construction/loading and session integration
Normal initialization, cross-entropy, stateful optimizers, convolution/pooling and mixed-precision training remain separate GPU gates
Paged caches, GPU sampling, recorded decode and quantized placement are not integrated by this batch
Existing host mask helpers such as Masks.padding are unchanged
Vulkan, full GPU Trainer workflows and end-to-end model performance were not verified
